4K.description: Lightweight retrieval: short excerpt from OpenAI case study, single-section fact lookup

6K.description: Moderate retrieval: medium excerpt from OpenAI case study, comparing early and later priorities

8K.description: Heavy retrieval: full OpenAI case study (~7.8K), must locate trade-offs across capability, safety, and deployment

10K.description: Extended retrieval: full OpenAI case study plus forward-looking trade-offs (~10K), tests longer-context retrieval and generation
